previousRule: The shared header provides a Shopify samples cart icon while the Design My Home Shopping Cart is available only through the main menu. A customer who leaves its Shopify draft-order checkout has no direct link back to that checkout from the saved order page.
newRule: The shared header provides separate, labelled shortcuts for fabric samples and the saved made-to-measure Shopping Cart. The saved order page offers a same-session link to resume a previously opened Shopify checkout when the saved order is unchanged. The checkout URL is validated, expires after 24 hours and is held in session storage. The production MAIN theme manifest records the updated six theme files.
reason: The owner asked for an unmistakable route between the samples cart, Design My Home Shopping Cart and Shopify checkout, including a way back to an interrupted checkout. The store is on Shopify Basic, so the hosted checkout cart link cannot be customised through Checkout Branding.
ownerApprovedDecision: Owner review is requested for the protected theme manifest and policy record on this production release PR. The repository requires an exact-head Nylon1 comment before merge; this field does not substitute for that comment.
